subject: Cross-cloud commitment consolidation and billing alignment
messages:
From: Joe Alvarez <j.alvarez@vertex-robotics.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@vertex-robotics.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating AWS + GCP commitments + term extension

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking the call last week. As discussed, Vertex is looking to tidy up our cloud commitments for Redwood across AWS and GCP. The short version: we want to consolidate our upcoming renewals into a coordinated plan so we can: (1) increase committed capacity by ~30% to cover Q4 pipeline, (2) extend the overall term from 12 to 18 months, and (3) simplify invoicing so that we get one consolidated monthly invoice or at most two tranches tied to marketplace/private-offer acceptance.

Specifically:
- AWS: we currently have a Private Offer with Redwood (PO on file). We want to add +350k units and accelerate acceptance if possible.
- GCP: we have a marketplace listing and would like to convert the renewal into a staged acceptance aligned with the AWS uplift.

Attached is a placeholder PO (Vertex_PO_Initial.pdf) and our procurement contact is copied on this thread. Our legal team will review any term sheets but wanted to start the billing/ops conversation.

Can you outline what you need from us to make: (A) expedited AWS uplift, (B) staged GCP rollover, and (C) a credit mapping for any unused commitment at the 18-month mark?

Thanks,
Joe

-- 
Joe Alvarez
Head of Procurement, Vertex Robotics
procurement@vertex-robotics.com
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Joe Alvarez <j.alvarez@vertex-robotics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating AWS + GCP commitments + term extension

Joe — thanks for the clear summary and the PO stub. We can definitely support a cross-cloud coordination plan; below is a pragmatic three-step mutual action plan to get you to signature and acceptance without blocking product capacity.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Fast-track AWS Private Offer uplift (target acceptance: within 10 business days of signed PO). Requires: signed PO, billing contact, and the Private Offer ID. Marissa will confirm the Private Offer ID and whether AWS wants a counter-signed PO vs. acceptance through their console.
2) Staged GCP marketplace rollover (target: staged activation — 50% now, 50% at month 6). Requires: confirmation of billing account and invoice delivery method. Dev will help map tranches to invoices.
3) Credit mapping and unused-commit policy (we will propose either prorated credit toward next term or one-time rebate; legal needs to sign off).

I’ve looped in Marissa (marketplace/private-offer specialist) and Dev (billing/finance) to scope the operational checklist and attachments. Marissa — can you confirm AWS Private Offer mechanics and whether we can accept the uplift off-cycle? Dev — once we have the PO number, can you share how the staged invoicing would look (monthly vs. two-tranche)?

I’ll prepare a short term summary for internal review and send a DocuSign link once we align on the final numbers.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, Joe Alvarez <j.alvarez@vertex-robotics.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating AWS + GCP commitments + term extension

Thanks — quick operational note from Marketplace side.

AWS Private Offer:
- We can create an off-cycle Private Offer amendment to add the +350k units. We need the signed PO and the billing email. AWS typically issues a Private Offer ID once we submit the amendment; acceptance on their side can be completed by the customer (you) or via counter-sign steps depending on account settings.
- Timing: once we submit to AWS it usually takes 2–4 business days to appear in the customer's console.

GCP Marketplace:
- GCP does not support the exact same private-offer flow; instead we do a staged activation via the marketplace subscription. We can do 50% activation now and the remainder scheduled on month 6. This requires a billing account change request and an invoice schedule (GCP invoices monthly).

Invoice & tranche proposal:
- Option A: Single consolidated monthly invoice (we run internal allocation & send a single PDF to your billing contact).
- Option B: Two-tranche invoicing — an immediate invoice for the AWS uplift (covers first 6 months of added units) and a deferred invoice for the staged GCP portion timed to month 6 activation.

I attached a Marketplace_Term_Summary.xlsx that maps the two options and shows the accounting entries we typically use for our finance teams. Dev — please confirm the tranche accounting for Redwood and whether we can support consolidated PDF invoices for Vertex.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: contracts@vertex-robotics.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@vertex-robotics.com
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating AWS + GCP commitments + term extension

Irene / Marissa — attached is our redlined PO (Signed_PO_Stub.pdf). A few ask items from legal/procurement: 
- We need a clear credit mechanism if actual consumption against the new commitment falls below 70% across the first 12 months. Prefer either a prorated credit or the option to move unused commitment to a 6-month extension.
- Invoice timing: we prefer two-tranche billing aligned with Q3 usage spikes (first tranche upon AWS acceptance, second tranche tied to GCP month-6 activation).
- Please include a clause that any marketplace conversion will not reset the start date of previously purchased capacity (i.e., no backdating new start).

If you can provide a final term sheet and a DocuSign link by EOD Tuesday (6/6), we will route for signature.

Regards,
Contracts Team
Vertex Robotics

Joe / Contracts — thanks for the redlines and the timing. Below is the operational checklist and final asks; I’ll drop the DocuSign link once Dev confirms the invoice tranche IDs.

Operational checklist (action owners / ETA):
1) Final numbers confirmed: +350k units (AWS uplift) / +200k units (GCP staged) — OWNER: Vertex (confirm by 6/6)
2) Signed PO uploaded to our portal and emailed to billing — OWNER: Vertex (6/6) — received: Signed_PO_Stub.pdf
3) AWS Private Offer amendment prepared by Redwood — OWNER: Marissa (submit to AWS 6/7)
4) GCP billing account change & staged activation scheduled — OWNER: Marissa/Dev (target activation slot: 6/21 for first tranche)
5) Invoice tranche mapping: Tranche 1 = AWS uplift invoice (immediate), Tranche 2 = GCP staged invoice (month 6). Dev to provide invoice IDs and consolidated PDF option — OWNER: Dev (ETA 6/7)
6) Credit mapping: we propose prorated credit applied to month 12 if utilization <70% (legal to finalize). OWNER: Redwood Legal / Vertex Legal (ETA 6/10)

Next steps: Dev — please confirm whether we can provide a single consolidated PDF invoice by customer billing contact and return DocuSign link for signature. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67891234 (VR-2028-084). DocuSign will be prepared once Dev confirms invoice mapping.

Thanks all — will follow up Monday with the DocuSign link and Private Offer ID.
